Appy Pie AppMakr

Appy Pie AppMakr is an online, no code app builder that lets anyone, irrespective of their technical skills, build an app on their own. Known for their extensive range of features, Appy Pie AppMakr is the single biggest no code mobile app development platform.

Appy Pie Website Builder

Appy Pie Website Builder lets individuals or business entities create websites without writing even a single line of code. The website builder from Appy Pie comes loaded with features and has unique offline capabilities

Users can access the platform through email/SMS verification, or via Google and Facebook login. Appy Pie does not store Google or Meta access tokens during authentication. All authentication credentials are securely managed through AWS Cognito, and no access tokens are retained or persisted by Appy Pie at any stage during user login.

Appy Pie Automate

Appy Pie Automate is an automation platform designed to streamline business operations by automating repetitive, manual tasks, thereby enhancing efficiency. As a seamless integration intermediary, we facilitate the transfer of data between platforms and target applications upon our clients' directives. Clients retain full control over access and are responsible for securing their data in the destination application.

Our role is strictly limited to transferring data without storing any platform data. The only information we retain related to platforms are encrypted access tokens, which are promptly updated with new tokens upon re-authentication or when the old tokens expire, adhering to platform guidelines.

We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy, ensuring that your data remains confidential and is handled with care throughout the transfer process. Appy Pie Automate stands as a reliable and secure conduit for your data integration needs, prioritizing your data's integrity every step of the way.

Appy Pie Agents

Appy Pie Agents offers an AI agent builder that allows individuals or businesses to create and integrate chatbots and AI agents into a website or an app without any coding. A chatbot or AI agent helps businesses offer a conversational touch point to their website visitors.

Pixazo (Formerly Appy Pie Design)

Pixazo is an online tool that empowers users to create different types of designs to fulfill their design needs without any design skills or training. Pixazo provides a wide range of templates, AI-driven creative tools, and a simple interface to help individuals, small businesses, and enterprises design logos, social media graphics, marketing materials, and more. Pixazo is currently under public beta phase.

Pixazo Fair Use and Responsible AI Policy

Users of Pixazo’s Unlimited Image Generation Plan are subject to the Pixazo Fair Use and Responsible AI Policy. This policy clarifies what “unlimited” means in practice, outlines acceptable and prohibited use of AI-generated resources, and ensures fair and responsible use of the platform’s computing capacity. Continued use of Pixazo constitutes acceptance of this policy in addition to these Terms of Use.

Zenifiq

Zenifiq is an all-in-one AI-powered content creation platform designed to help users generate high-quality digital assets effortlessly. From text, images, and videos to voiceovers and AI agents, Zenifiq empowers creators, marketers, and businesses to produce engaging content in seconds—no technical skills required. By combining intelligent automation with an intuitive interface, it simplifies the creative process, making it faster and more accessible for everyone.

AI-generated content

Appy Pie AppMakr

Appy Pie AppMakr is an online, no code app builder that lets anyone, irrespective of their technical skills, build an app on their own. Known for their extensive range of features, Appy Pie AppMakr is the single biggest no code mobile app development platform.

Appy Pie Website Builder

Users can access the platform through email/SMS verification, or via Google and Facebook login. Appy Pie does not store Google or Meta access tokens during authentication. All authentication credentials are securely managed through AWS Cognito, and no access tokens are retained or persisted by Appy Pie at any stage during user login.

Appy Pie Automate

Appy Pie Automate is an automation platform designed to streamline business operations by automating repetitive, manual tasks, thereby enhancing efficiency. As a seamless integration intermediary, we facilitate the transfer of data between platforms and target applications upon our clients' directives. Clients retain full control over access and are responsible for securing their data in the destination application.

Our role is strictly limited to transferring data without storing any platform data. The only information we retain related to platforms are encrypted access tokens, which are promptly updated with new tokens upon re-authentication or when the old tokens expire, adhering to platform guidelines.

We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy, ensuring that your data remains confidential and is handled with care throughout the transfer process. Appy Pie Automate stands as a reliable and secure conduit for your data integration needs, prioritizing your data's integrity every step of the way.

Appy Pie Agents

Appy Pie Agents offers an AI agent builder that allows individuals or businesses to create and integrate chatbots and AI agents into a website or an app without any coding. A chatbot or AI agent helps businesses offer a conversational touch point to their website visitors.

Pixazo (Formerly Appy Pie Design)

Pixazo is an online tool that empowers users to create different types of designs to fulfill their design needs without any design skills or training. Pixazo provides a wide range of templates, AI-driven creative tools, and a simple interface to help individuals, small businesses, and enterprises design logos, social media graphics, marketing materials, and more. Pixazo is currently under public beta phase.

Zenifiq

Zenifiq is an all-in-one AI-powered content creation platform designed to help users generate high-quality digital assets effortlessly. From text, images, and videos to voiceovers and AI agents, Zenifiq empowers creators, marketers, and businesses to produce engaging content in seconds—no technical skills required.
